cases.sentence: На пятом году царствования Раваама пришел на него ___.
cases.translation: In the fifth year of King Rehoboam's reign, Shishak came against him.
cases.explain: The subject of the verb 'пришел' (came) uses the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Со своим огромным войском он завоевал укрепленные города ___.
cases.translation: With his vast army, he conquered the fortified cities of Judah.
cases.explain: The genitive case shows possession and relationship.

cases.sentence: Шимаи пророк пришел к Равааму и сказал ему: «Вы оставили Бога, поэтому Бог оставил вас в руках ___».
cases.translation: The prophet Shemaiah came to Rehoboam and said to him: 'You have forsaken God, therefore God has forsaken you into the hand of Shishak.'
cases.explain: The preposition 'в руках' (in the hands of) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Тогда Раваам и князья Израиля смирились и сказали: Господь ___.
cases.translation: Then Rehoboam and the princes of Israel humbled themselves and said: The Lord is just.
cases.explain: The predicate adjective uses the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Когда Господь увидел, что они смирились, слово Господа пришло к Шимаи: «Они смирились, не истреблю их, но скоро дам им ___».
cases.translation: When the Lord saw that they humbled themselves, the word of the Lord came to Shemaiah: 'They have humbled themselves; I will not destroy them, but soon I will give them deliverance.'
cases.explain: The direct object of the verb 'дам' (will give) takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Мой гнев не будет излит на них в ___.
cases.translation: My wrath will not be poured out upon them this year.
cases.explain: The preposition 'в' (in) with temporal meaning governs the prepositional case.
The preposition 'в' (in) indicating location governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Со своим войском Шишак завоевал множество ___.
cases.translation: With his army, Shishak conquered many cities.
cases.explain: After 'множество' (many/multitude), the genitive plural is used.

reading.ru: На пятом году царствования Раваама пришел на него Шишак, царь Египта, со своим огромным войском.
reading.question: Who invaded Judah during King Rehoboam's reign?
reading.explain: The text states 'Шишак, царь Египта' — Shishak, king of Egypt came.

reading.ru: Со своим огромным войском, состоящим из тысяч колесниц и всадников, он завоевал укрепленные города Иудеи.
reading.question: What forces did Shishak use to conquer Judah?
reading.explain: The text mentions 'тысяч колесниц и всадников' — thousands of chariots and horsemen.

reading.ru: Шимаи пророк пришел к Равааму и сказал ему: «Вы оставили Бога, поэтому Бог оставил вас в руках Шишака».
reading.question: What did the prophet Shemaiah tell King Rehoboam?
options: That they had forsaken God and God had given them into Shishak's hand
That they should flee to Egypt
reading.correct: That they had forsaken God and God had given them into Shishak's hand
reading.explain: The prophet said 'Вы оставили Бога, поэтому Бог оставил вас' — you have forsaken God, therefore God has forsaken you.

reading.ru: Тогда Раваам и князья Израиля смирились и сказали: Господь справедлив.
reading.question: How did King Rehoboam and the princes respond to this message?
options: They humbled themselves and acknowledged God's justice
reading.correct: They humbled themselves and acknowledged God's justice
reading.explain: The text says 'смирились и сказали: Господь справедлив' — they humbled themselves and said: The Lord is just.

reading.ru: Когда Господь увидел, что они смирились, слово Господа пришло к Шимаи: «Они смирились, не истреблю их, но скоро дам им избавление».
reading.question: What did God promise when He saw Judah's repentance?
options: He would not destroy them completely but would soon give them deliverance
He would send them more trials
He would give them to Shishak completely
He would restore their kingdom immediately
reading.correct: He would not destroy them completely but would soon give them deliverance
reading.explain: God's word through Shemaiah says 'не истреблю их, но скоро дам им избавление' — I will not destroy them, but soon will give them deliverance.

reading.ru: Мой гнев не будет излит на них в этом году, но под рабством они узнают разницу между служением Мне и служением царям земли».
reading.question: What did God say about His judgment on Judah?
options: His wrath would not be poured out on them at that time, but they would learn the difference between serving Him and serving earthly kings
He would forgive them without any punishment
reading.correct: His wrath would not be poured out on them at that time, but they would learn the difference between serving Him and serving earthly kings
reading.explain: God said 'Мой гнев не будет излит на них в этом году, но под рабством они узнают разницу' — my wrath will not be poured out, but through slavery they will learn.
